cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: To acquaint the students with original, topical and potential sources of radioactive waste and their effect in the area of agriculture, food industry and forestry; with the system of waste monitoring to detect radio-contamination; with standards (legislation) and methods of handling radionuclide-contaminated biological waste. The student will master information applicable in the protection of agricultural, food and forest production against radioactive waste, including methods of handling contaminated agricultural products.
